bust.note: Dealer-listed manufacturer specification; not measured on user's doll.

shoulder_width.note: Dealer-listed manufacturer specification; point definition to verify.

neck.note: Recorded for reference, not a closed collar draft.

shoulder_to_wrist.note: Reference only; detached sleeve begins below shoulder.

shoulder_to_waist.note: First fitting hypothesis, replace with actual torso length.

armhole_depth.note: From shoulder-neck height; check underarm clearance.

bust_line_y.note: Chest line from shoulder-neck height; side stays vertical until this line.

neck_half_width.note: Open prototype neckline, not a measured neck diameter.

front_neck_depth.note: Prototype neckline; replace for costume finish.

back_neck_depth.note: Prototype neckline at open centre back.

dart_x.note: Quarter-panel waist dart centre from CF/CB; fit to bust position.

front_dart_apex_y.note: Waist dart apex from shoulder-neck height.

back_dart_apex_y.note: Waist dart apex from shoulder-neck height.

hip_depth.note: Radial distance below skirt waist; check doll's hip level.

upper_arm.note: For separate sleeve tube test only; not a brand measurement.

wrist.note: For sleeve test only; hand passing size remains unknown.

bust_ease.note: Total circumference ease for muslin trial.

waist_ease.note: Total circumference ease for muslin trial.

hip_ease_min.note: Minimum circumference check at assumed hip depth.

quarter_side_reduction.note: Remaining waist suppression is assigned to one dart per quarter.

skirt_length.note: Radial length for base muslin, not final irregular costume hem.

skirt_angle_degrees.note: Half-circle skirt split into four equal sectors.

skirt_back_opening.note: Leave centre-back seam open below waist for fitting.

pleats_per_half.note: Design trial: 8 knife pleats total, not an observed official count.

pleated_hem_band.note: Optional light-colour hem band guide; not yet a separate trim pattern.

sleeve_length.note: Detached open tube test; no sleeve head or finished cuff.

sleeve_wrist_ease.note: Wrist ease does not prove hand can pass.

seam_allowance.note: All edges except front fold; temporary muslin edges only.
